summary: Phase 149O.12B -- HATP Signing Ceremony Resolver + Orchestrator Implementation: bounded production implementation phase (Wave C + Wave D of the 149O.11 plan only -- no CLI, no AG3/AG5 consumption wiring, no rollback/Permission Broker changes, no HATP production activation, no Class-B provisioning). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.12A) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, 149O.12A completed/complete/pushed, HSCE-001 v1.1 unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full HSCE-001 v1.1 contract, the 149O.11 implementation plan, the 149O.12A phase report, HATP-001, and RAE-001 directly, plus the existing production source (hatp_signed_evidence.py, hatp_evidence_store.py, human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, hatp_providers.py, hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_hardware_credentials.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_ag_authority.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, repository_identity.py, and the relevant read-only surface of agent.py) to reuse exact existing function/class names and conventions rather than inventing plausible-sounding ones. Implemented exactly one new production module, src/pcae/core/hatp_signing_ceremony.py: resolve_signing_context (AG3 job_id -> original_commit_sha via agent.py::build_rollback_review; AG5 per_id -> ecp_id via agent.py::lookup_promotion_execution_record; both fail operation_not_found before any RAE Binding lookup or hardware touch -- attacks 20/21) plus supersession-aware, revocation-excluding RAE Binding resolution (ambiguous ties fail closed as binding_unavailable, never a human-disambiguation prompt -- attack 19) plus Decision-reference reuse from the matched Binding plus repository-identity resolution; and sign_rollback_evidence, the internal test-injectable orchestrator implementing the canonical blind-touch-defense + TOCTOU sequence: resolve context A -> resolve provider/signer identity -> render preview -> require explicit human confirmation (human_signing_cancelled if declined, still no hardware touch) -> generate issued_at and construct the HumanApprovalProvenanceProof -> invoke provider.request_signature exactly once (the sole physical hardware touch) -> re-resolve context B and compare against A via frozen-dataclass equality on every HSCE-required stable field, discarding the signed assertion with no publish and no automatic re-sign on any mismatch -> build the envelope via 149O.12A's build_hatp_signed_evidence_envelope and publish via 149O.12A's HATPEvidenceStore.publish, propagating EvidenceConflictError/EvidencePersistenceFailureError unmodified. production_sign_rollback_evidence is the zero-override production entry point (signature is exactly {root, site, job_id, per_id} -- F-2 non-regression, mirroring hatp_ag_authority.py's own zero-override production-adapter discipline); its own production defaults resolve exclusively through create_production_hardware_provider(HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1) and HATPTrustStore.production(). A closed, 10-member HATPSigningCeremonyError hierarchy (plus the two propagated 149O.12A store errors, totaling exactly HSCE-001's closed 12-member error_type vocabulary) maps every failure mode; no error_type outside that vocabulary is introduced. Wrote 86 new tests across two files (44 in tests/test_hatp_signing_ceremony.py -- real filesystem throughout (job/PER records, RAE Bindings via the real create_rollback_approval_decision/create_rollback_approval_binding pipeline, real repository identity, real .pcae/hatp-evidence/ envelopes), only the hardware provider and trust store are deterministic in-memory fakes; covers AG3/AG5 resolver success/failure including attacks 20/21, missing/ambiguous/superseded/revoked Binding resolution (attack 19), repository-identity failure, no-authorized-signer, preview-before-touch ordering with exactly-one-provider-call on both the success and every TOCTOU-failure path, cancellation (attack 16) including declined preview confirmation, hardware device fault distinct from cancellation, generic provider-exception mapping, TOCTOU mismatch on each of Decision/Decision-digest/Binding/Binding-digest/operation/repository (attack 18, both monkeypatched-deterministic and a real RAE-mutation integration test), envelope built through the 149O.12A factory only, store publish outcome mapping, whole-millisecond timestamp edge cases, and module import with no hardware/fido2 present; 42 in tests/test_phase_149o_12b_hatp_signing_ceremony_implementation.py covering a git-derived production-diff allowlist pinned to the 149O.12A baseline commit, no CLI module/registration, no Permission Broker import, no verify_hatp_proof/HATPVerificationStatus usage, no legacy approval-state mutation or rollback-dispatch call, no approval_present derivation, contract byte-identity for HSCE-001/HATP-001/RAE-001, 149O.12A's two modules byte-unchanged, no-authority-bearing-field checks, production-wrapper zero-override structural checks, static preview-before-touch/TOCTOU-before-publish source-ordering checks, closed-error-vocabulary membership, lazy-import/optional-hardware-dependency discipline, and a required-attack-subset presence check). Widened three existing semantic production-file-allowlist tests (test_phase_149o_1e_..., test_phase_149o_1g_..., test_phase_149o_12a_...::TestProductionFileAllowlist) to name this phase's new module, applying the retained 149O.5-F-3 lesson exactly as 149O.12A's own report documented it would be for the next intentional new HATP module; removed 149O.12A's now-permanently-obsolete test_no_signing_ceremony_module_created negative assertion, whose non-existence invariant was correctly scoped only through 149O.12A's own completion. Ran and reconfirmed non-regression: tests/test_hatp_signed_evidence.py (84 passed, unchanged), tests/test_hatp_evidence_store.py (48 passed, unchanged), tests/test_phase_149o_12a_signed_evidence_model_store_implementation.py (44 passed, same count after the allowlist-widening edits); a full -k "hatp or rollback_approval" sweep in this repository's canonical .venv (Python 3.9.6) showing zero new failures beyond this environment's pre-existing, unrelated failures -- independently confirmed via a git-stash-based clean-baseline A/B comparison run (195 failed/1926 passed/53 errors before this phase's changes, 195 failed/2011 passed/53 errors after, an exact +85 delta matching 85 of this phase's 86 new tests, the 86th accounted for by this phase's own new test module briefly tripping the then-still-idle governed task's file-scope check mid-implementation, resolved once the proper 149O.12B task was opened -- not a code regression); and Fast Green (4828 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, after newly registering test_hatp_signing_ceremony in tests/conftest.py::FAST_GREEN_MODULES -- an exact +44 delta over the 149O.12A-entering baseline of 4784 passed, matching exactly this phase's own newly Fast-Green-registered tests). A genuine, pre-existing, wholly unrelated Python-3.9 defect was independently discovered and diagnosed during this phase's own verification: pcae.governance.publication.coordinator._parse_timestamp (Phase 144C) calls bare datetime.fromisoformat(value) without normalizing a trailing 'Z', which datetime.fromisoformat only accepts starting Python 3.11 -- on this repository's minimum-supported Python 3.9 .venv, this causes RollbackApprovalDecisionCreationError inside PublicationCoordinator._validate_authorization_freshness for any real create_rollback_approval_decision call, and was independently confirmed (via git stash -u) to already affect numerous pre-existing, already-merged test files (e.g. tests/test_rollback_approval_evidence_persistence.py, tests/test_phase_149o_5_hatp_rae_integration_independent_verification.py) before this phase's changes existed. Fixing coordinator.py is out of this phase's scope (149O.12B may add exactly one new file); tests/test_hatp_signing_ceremony.py instead carries a test-layer-only, module-scoped autouse pytest fixture that monkeypatches only the imported coordinator._parse_timestamp reference for the duration of this test module, so this phase's own new tests are deterministically green on Python 3.9 without touching any production file -- this pre-existing coordinator.py defect is flagged here as a non-blocking finding for a future, separately-scoped governed phase. VERDICT: HATP SIGNING CEREMONY RESOLVER + ORCHESTRATOR: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR 149O.12C. Not a claim of full HSCE-001 implementation -- only Wave C (proof-context resolution) and Wave D (signing-ceremony orchestration) of the 149O.11 plan's six-wave decomposition; Wave E (CLI) and Wave F (integrated attack-matrix suite) remain unimplemented, scheduled for 149O.12C. No CLI implemented, no hardware touched, no signing occurred outside this phase's own deterministic tests, no .pcae/hatp-evidence/ production directory created by this phase's own code. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, and RAE-001 v1.0 all remain byte-unchanged. 149O.12A's two modules remain byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_12B_HATP_SIGNING_CEREMONY_RESOLVER_ORCHESTRATOR_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.12C, HATP Signing CLI Integration + Full HSCE Attack-Matrix Implementation.

validation_results.name: binding_decision_resolution_no_guessing
validation_results.result: Binding resolution excludes revoked candidates, applies supersession-aware selection (strictly-latest created_at) only among candidates already matching the exact operation, and fails closed as binding_unavailable on zero matches or any ambiguity (tie or unparseable timestamp) -- never a 'pick the newest across distinct operations' shortcut, never a human-disambiguation prompt (attack 19). validation_results.name: toctou_recheck_before_publish_confirmed
